summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing a 1-for-8 reverse share split of its no-par common shares, consolidating every eight shares into one, with Nasdaq Capital Market trading on a split-adjusted basis beginning Monday, October 5, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from 4,059,227 to 507,404, subject to fractional rounding up, while authorized capital stays unchanged; option and warrant exercise prices and share counts adjust proportionately and the new CUSIP is 185053709. Watch liquidity, any Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance cure, and potential subsequent financing overhang.
